findings.evidence: 'Do Next is the next-highest idea whose test fits a stated later window'. I followed this branch for each eval prompt (team size given, no later window given): the branch can never fire, so every non-Do-Now, non-Massive idea falls to Backlog, and the 'Do Next' label in the template and the README is never reached.
findings.fix: Define a default window when none is stated, for example: 'Do Next is the next-highest idea whose cheapest test fits the stated later window, or, when none is stated, the next quarter at the stated team size; say which window you used in Scope and assumptions.'
